as per Orlando's text ?

John

Orlando Oriundus
Clan: Tremere antitribu (group 4)
Capacity: 9
Disciplines: AUS DOM THA obf
Sabbat bishop: During a referendum, if Orlando is ready, your
vampires' votes are doubled when votes are tallied, and other
multipliers may not be played on your vampires. +1 bleed.

Capacity: 9
Disciplines: AUS DOM FOR THA
Camarilla: If Gerald has no title, he gets an additional vote for each
ready titled vampire controlled by other Methuselahs. +1 stealth.

Messages.Author: Francis Plamondon
Messages.Body:
As something of a follow-up question, does Orlando's card text double
the votes Gerald gains from his own card text, or does it multiply his
basic votes (which are zero unless there are other titled vampires in
play)? It would seem logical that the multiplier is added last, since
it applies "when votes are tallied" and thus takes effect after any
other modifiers have been played, but it never hurts to be too sure.

(on a side note, if you put out both of these guys and try to play
politics with neither of them having Presence, I'd love to see your
deck!).

Merci,
Francis.
